shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,105p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && rg -n -C 3 'table|icons' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat package.json src/App.tsx src/main.tsx && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"

/bin/bash -lc ".agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Table withTableSorting withTableSelection Pagination Button TextInput Select DropdownMenu Modal Checkbox Text Label Avatar ThemeProvider && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit | rg 'Table.*(d.ts|README)|Pagination.*(d.ts|README)|TextInput.*d.ts|Select.*d.ts|DropdownMenu.*d.ts|Modal.*d.ts|Checkbox.*d.ts|Avatar.*d.ts|Text.*d.ts|Button.*d.ts'"

/bin/bash -lc "bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Table withTableSorting withTableSelection Pagination Button TextInput Select DropdownMenu Modal Checkbox Text Label Avatar ThemeProvider && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit | rg 'Table.*(d.ts|README)|Pagination.*(d.ts|README)|TextInput.*d.ts|Select.*d.ts|DropdownMenu.*d.ts|Modal.*d.ts|Checkbox.*d.ts|Avatar.*d.ts|Text.*d.ts|Button.*d.ts'"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/README.md && rg -n 'Magnifier|ArrowDownToLine|Plus|Sliders|Chevron|CircleQuestion|Bell|Persons|PersonPlus|ArrowUpRight|CircleCheck|Archive|LayoutColumns|Xmark|CircleInfo|ArrowRightFromSquare|Moon|Sun' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts && rg -n -C 2 'multiple|options|onUpdate|renderControl|value|placeholder|width|size' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.js && rg -o -- '--g-color-(base|text|line)-(info|positive|warning|utility|neutral|simple|generic|float|background)[a-z-]*' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | sort -u"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,125p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts && sed -n '1,150p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts && cat tsconfig.json index.html && rg -n 'onUpdate|controlProps|indeterminate' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts && rg -n 'row|header|cell|--g-table' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/Table.css"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -- '--g-button-(padding|background|text)|--g-border-radius-|--g-color-text-light-solid|--g-text-header-1-font-size' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.css node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -65 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Pagination/Pagination.js && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.js | head -125 && git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -o -- '--g-color-text-[a-z-]+' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | sort -u && sed -n '1,100p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md && rg -n -C 2 'text-light|brand-contrast|base-info-heavy|text-dark' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/themes/light.css node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -65 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenuPopup.js | head -100 && rg --files -g '*test*' -g '"'!node_modules/**'"' -g '"'!dist/**'"'"

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module -e 'import fs from \"node:fs\"; const css = fs.readFileSync(\"src/styles.css\", \"utf8\"); const base = fs.readFileSync(\"node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css\", \"utf8\"); const definitions = new Set([...base.matchAll(/(--g-[a-z0-9-]+)\\s*:/g), ...css.matchAll(/(--g-[a-z0-9-]+)\\s*:/g)].map(x => x[1])); console.log(\"Undefined referenced tokens:\", [...new Set([...css.matchAll(/var\\((--g-[a-z0-9-]+)/g)].map(x => x[1]))].filter(x => "'!definitions.has(x)));'"'"
